# Baya Weaver Resorts

> Pre-opening resort in Old Vythiri, Wayanad, Kerala, India: 14 villas (four with private plunge pools), one open pool and a clubhouse on 3.27 acres of Highland Tea Estate. Under construction; target opening Q4 2026. Designs by Sumayyasalih Architects.

- Status: under construction (latest site update dated 22 March 2026). Bookings are not open yet.
- Location: Old Vythiri, Wayanad District, Kerala 673576. Coordinates 11.535045, 76.038681.
- Getting there: about 80 km (around 90 minutes) from Calicut International Airport (CCJ); about 70 km from Kozhikode, 90 km from Mysore and 270 km from Bangalore via NH766.
- Villa designs shown: 2BHK Pool Villa, Single Bed Villa. Images marked "render" are proposed designs.
- Contact: bayaweaverresort@gmail.com
- Enquiries accepted: site visits, villa ownership, investment, trade, future stays, brochure requests. The website does not take bookings or payments.
